user.title: Connect to Hoymiles DTU-Pro
user.description: Establish a Modbus TCP connection to your DTU-Pro. The DTU's serial number will be used as the unique device ID.

data_description.unit_id: Modbus slave ID. Default is 1; change only if you know what you're doing.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Hoymiles DTU-Pro
reconfigure.description: Update connection details. The DTU serial must match the one originally configured.

data_description.unit_id: Modbus slave ID. Default is 1; change only if you know what you're doing.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to reach the DTU. Check the host, port and network.

abort.another_device: A different DTU is responding at this host. Configuration aborted to avoid mixing devices.

init.title: Hoymiles DTU-Pro options
init.description: Tune the integration to your installation. Default values are conservative and safe for production use.

data.co2_factor_kg_per_kwh: CO2 emission factor (kg CO2 per kWh)
data.tree_kg_co2_per_year: CO2 absorbed per young planted tree per year (kg)

data_description.scan_interval_real_data: How often to fetch live power/voltage/current data. Minimum 10 s, default 60 s. Lower values stress the DTU.
data_description.scan_interval_metadata: How often to fetch slow-changing data (link status, alarm count). Minimum 60 s, default 300 s.
data_description.timeout_s: How long to wait for a single Modbus response before timing out. Default 5 s.
data_description.retry_attempts: Maximum attempts per fetch on transient errors (connection lost, timeout). Each attempt opens a fresh TCP socket. Default 3, max 10.
data_description.backoff_initial_s: Delay before the first retry. Default 0.5 s. The delay doubles after each failed attempt up to the maximum.
data_description.backoff_max_s: Upper bound for the exponential backoff. Default 4 s. Must be at least equal to the initial backoff.
data_description.dtu_unreachable_threshold_min: How long the DTU must be silent before raising a Repair Issue. Note: after a settings change, this counter is reset — the issue cannot fire until at least one successful poll occurs and is then followed by the threshold of silence.
data_description.inverter_offline_threshold_h: How long an inverter must report no RF link before raising a Repair Issue. Reset on integration reload — the timer restarts after every options change.
data_description.co2_factor_kg_per_kwh: Default 0.5 reflects a balanced European-average grid carbon intensity. Reference values: France/RTE 2024: 0.053 (very low carbon, nuclear), EU mix: 0.30, Germany: 0.50, Hoymiles app default: 1.0 (coal-grid marketing), coal-dominant: 1.0+.
data_description.tree_kg_co2_per_year: Default 25 follows the ADEME (France) standard for a mature European tree. The Hoymiles app uses 18 (young planted trees, growth phase). Tropical mature trees can reach 50.

error.backoff_initial_above_max: Initial backoff cannot be greater than the maximum backoff.

set_inverter_limit.name: Set inverter limit
set_inverter_limit.description: Sets the persistent maximum AC output power for a specific Hoymiles inverter.

inverter_serial.name: Inverter serial number
inverter_serial.description: 12-character hexadecimal serial of the target inverter.

limit_w.name: Limit (W)
limit_w.description: Maximum AC output power in watts.

dtu_unreachable.title: DTU-Pro unreachable
dtu_unreachable.description: The DTU-Pro at `{host}` has been unreachable for more than 5 minutes. Check the DTU's power supply, network cable and that port 502 is open. The integration will recover automatically once Modbus polling succeeds again.

inverter_offline_long.title: Inverter offline for over 6 hours
inverter_offline_long.description: Inverter `{serial}` has reported no RF link for more than 6 hours. Possible causes: panel shaded or covered, RF interference, defective inverter. Check the device page for the per-inverter `link` binary sensor and the most recent alarm code.
